[LDEB.4.3.3] Further breakpoint kinds, beside [LDEB.4.3.1]'s:

| Breakpoint kind | Fires when |
|---|---|
| On rule not-fire | a specific rule's LHS matched but was suppressed (refraction, mode) |
| On logical-fact flip | a logical fact retracts or reasserts |
| On `call` | any `call` to a service, or one matching adapter/domain/method |
| On adapter response | any response fact ([LCRS.4.3.1]) or `CallError`, or one by correlation id |
| On timer expiry | a `cooldown` or `retain` timer expires |
| On tick | every tick, or the N-th tick |
| On cross-tier emit | any fact crossing a tier boundary |
